```{r}
# --- 5. Run Scraper ---
# Get Data for Chunk
chunk_dt <- get(current_chunk, envir = .GlobalEnv)
total_links <- nrow(chunk_dt)

message(sprintf("\nStarting to process %d links from chunk %s...", total_links, current_chunk))
message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))

# Initialize counters
successful_count <- 0
retry_count <- 0
error_count <- 0
parse_error_count <- 0

# Process Links 
if (total_links > 0) {
  for (i in 1:total_links) {
    link_info <- chunk_dt[i]
    
    message(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] Processing: %s", i, total_links, link_info$url))
    
    # --- complete Request -> Analysis -> Parse Pipeline ---
    request_package <- func_04_prepare_request(id = link_info$id, url = link_info$url, domain = link_info$domain, chunk_dt = chunk_dt)
    
    if (request_package$success) {
      response_result <- func_05_execute_request(request_package = request_package, chunk_name = current_chunk, worker_id = 1)
      analysis_result <- func_07_analyze_response(response_result = response_result, chunk_name = current_chunk)
      
      # Update status
      if (analysis_result$action == "parse") {
        if (isTRUE(analysis_result$parse_result$success)) {
          successful_count <- successful_count + 1
          message("--> Status: SUCCESS")
        } else {
          parse_error_count <- parse_error_count + 1
          message(sprintf("--> Status: PARSE_ERROR (%s)", analysis_result$parse_result$reason))
        }
      } else if (analysis_result$action == "retry") {
        retry_count <- retry_count + 1
        message(sprintf("--> Status: RETRY (%s)", analysis_result$response_analysis))
      } else { # "error"
        error_count <- error_count + 1
        message(sprintf("--> Status: ERROR (%s)", analysis_result$message))
      }
    } else {
      message(sprintf("Failed to prepare request: %s", request_package$message))
      func_10_append_error(error_reason = request_package$message, processed_dt = data.table(id = link_info$id, domain = link_info$domain, url = link_info$url), chunk_name = current_chunk)
      error_count <- error_count + 1
    }
    
    # --- CHECKPOINT-LOGIC ---
    if (i %% 1000 == 0 && i < total_links) {
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
        message(sprintf("CHECKPOINT: Saving data after %d requests...", i))
        func_09_fill_output(current_chunk)
        message("CHECKPOINT: Emptying data structures.")
        func_09_init_data_structures(current_chunk)
        message("CHECKPOINT: Finished.")
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
    }
  }
}

message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
message("CHUNK PROCESSING COMPLETE.")

```
